COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No. 1916 of 2023
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Tribhuwan Chandra Pandey, 
learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Sachin Mohan Singh Mehta, 
learned Brief Holder for the State of 
Uttarakhand.
3. By means of this writ petition, 
petitioner seeks indulgence of this Court for 
quashing the Final Due Certificate dated 
06.07.2023 issued by respondent no.4 
(Annexure No.3) and letter dated 11.07.2023 
issued by respondent no.5 (Annexure No.5) 
whereby the amount of Rs. 5,46,329/- has 
been recovered from the gratuity of the 
petitioner.
4. It is the contention of the petitioner 
that the petitioner has retired on 30.06.2023
from the regular post of Beldar from the 
office of P.W.D., Lansdowne, Pauri Garhwal.
5. By the impugned orders, the aforesaid 
amount has been directed to be recovered 
from the petitioner without any show-cause 
and without any opportunity of hearing to 
the petitioner, which is arbitrary and illegal.
6. Learned State counsel prays for and is 
granted six weeks’ time for filing counter 
affidavit. Two weeks’ time thereafter is 
granted for filing rejoinder affidavit.
7. List on 18.12.2023.
 
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 12.10.2023
PN
